items.title: Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack
items.summary: Binance reopens customer withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion exploit.

items.title: Binance diz que a primeira fase dos saques é aberta após hack de US$ 6,3 bilhões
items.summary: A corretora de criptomoedas disse que iniciou saques em fases após o hack recorde que o FBI atribuiu à Coreia do Norte.

items.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
items.summary: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this…

items.title: Binance diz que 90% dos ativos roubados foram repostos e prevê saques no domingo
items.summary: Tokens menos líquidos compõem o déficit restante, enquanto a Binance continua comprando ativos substitutos em negociações no mercado e de balcão.

items.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
items.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

items.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
items.summary: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC.

items.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion

items.title: Hackeamento recorde de US$ 6,3 bilhões na Binance provoca confrontos políticos antes das eleições
items.summary: Algumas figuras políticas e do governo tentaram tirar proveito do maior roubo de criptomoedas já registrado.
